pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Turns your own health into power that removes the same amount of health from a target.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() Path level 15.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: Hold the ability key to charge it. Each charge costs one heart, but leaves you with at least half a heart. Release the key to attack a target at range.
